namespaces.core: Global reusable classification and semantic-context metadata

dimensions.core.tag: A reusable metadata tag attached to a typed platform entity

core.record.context.meaning: A reusable context label that qualifies an entity without replacing typed attributes or changing authorization.

core.evaluation.purpose.meaning: Identifies synthetic records intentionally approved for an evaluation purpose; allowlist membership remains the access control.

compatibility_policy.additive_change: publish a new compatible schema version
compatibility_policy.meaning_or_value_type_change: publish a new schema version and preserve the prior definition
compatibility_policy.deprecation: mark deprecated and provide replaced_by in the new schema version
